entities.summary: Gerald Anthony Robinson Jr. is an American professional basketball player for Rimini of the Italian Serie A2. Standing at 6 ft 1 in (1.85 m), he plays at the point guard and shooting guard positions. He played college basketball for Tennessee State and Georgia.
